notes.title: VSync Now Available and Softlock Fixed for Single Player Races
notes.content:
VSync is now an option at the bottom of the settings menu. 
 The softlock after crashing in single player races has been resolved.

notes.title: Mini Seasons (Up to 36 races) are working with in-game points standings!
notes.content:
You can now select "Mini Season" when starting a server. This will initiate "Season Mode" which will allow you to track points for the duration of the season.

A few notes:


 As of right now, a user must finish the first race of the season in order to be added to the standings and subsequently have their points tallied. Working on a fix for this!
 Season standings can be viewed when you return to the lobby. There will be a UI element automatically populated on your screen. 


Also in this build:


 Shortened up the intro cinematics for each race, to save about 10 seconds. 
 Removed duplicate chat widgets for spectators and before the race starts when input is disabled.

notes.title: Updated drafting physics & netcode update
notes.content:
Further improvements to the drafting physics
 Small netcode update

notes.title: Game Menu Glitch Fixed
notes.content: Fixed an issue where you'd try to collapse the game menu and it would overlay another menu on top of it in certain scenarios. This was introduced a couple of builds ago. Early access things.

notes.title: Text chat enabled
notes.content:
Text chat is enabled!

[olist]
 You can now chat in both the PP Lounge and Race Sessions. 
 There will probably be a couple of scenarios where input is disabled and you cannot text chat, but I will iron out those issues soon.
[/olist]

notes.title: v1.65
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that would stop the race from finishing.

Adjusted physics for the leader to make leading less overpowered.

notes.title: v1.62
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the server's car would crash out of the race and sometimes delete all of the cars

May have fixed an issue where spectators would see the race running order fill the entire screen and make it so the user cannot see the race.

Fixed issue where players couldn't see running order as cars cross the line to complete a lap after crashing out of the race.

Added logic so players do not inherit crash camera if they are about to slide across the line wrecking on the final lap

Tweaked crash physics and likelihood

Top speed adjusted for all cars

Changed blowover effect so cars catch more air

Moved the finish line camera back so players can see more of the chaos

Steering sensitivity has been tweaked
Fixed an issue where AI cars were crashing too frequently.
